notes.text: CCNL 2024-2026 (CONFITARMA/FILT-CGIL/FIT-CISL/UILTRASPORTI), signed 11/07/2024, valid 01/07/2024-31/12/2026. Personale di terra (shore-based staff), Sezione 15 — Allegati 1 and 1bis.

SPLIT model: minimo contrattuale (base_salary) + EAR Elemento Aggiuntivo della Retribuzione (per-level, omnicomprensivo) modelled as fixed_allowance. 3 tranches: 01/07/2024 (40%), 01/07/2025 (30%), 01/07/2026 (30%).
VIIQ (Quadri): VII minimo + INDENNITA_FUNZIONE EUR 225.00/month fixed (since June 2007, not indexed). Included in TFR, 13th and 14th month, festivity. NOT included in overtime base.
HOURLY DIVISOR: 173 (Art. 10 para 8). Daily divisor: 26. Verified on 3 levels: L1=1509.42/173=8.72, LIV=1989.32/173=11.50, LVII=2800.07/173=16.18.
ADDITIONAL MONTHS: 14 — tredicesima (Christmas) and quattordicesima (Easter/summer). Art. 17: base = minimo + superminimo + scatti + contributo mensa + indennita funzione.
SENIORITY: 24-month cadence (biennale), max 5 for workers hired from 1989 onwards. Per-level EUR from Allegato 1: I=23.74, II=24.41, III=25.76, IV=29.35, V=30.47, VI=34.39, VII=36.07.
APPRENTICESHIP: professionalizzante, eligible levels III-VI only. Months 1-12: 70% of minimo; months 13-36: 80% of minimo. Minimum 6 months, maximum 36 months.

PRE-2024 HISTORY: prior CCNL signed 16/12/2020. Values before 01/07/2024 not modelled. From the 2020 contract PDF (usclac.it): terra salary tables were in Allegato 2 (tabelle retributive per il personale di terra, 2021-2023 tranches). Sezione 15 (uffici e terminals) specifically references Allegato 9 "in formato elettronico" — a separate electronic file not embedded in the scanned PDF. Neither Allegato 2 (scanned, image-only) nor Allegato 9 (separate file) is machine-readable. Engine history starts at 01/07/2024.

SENIORITY MAX: CCNL provides 10 max increments for workers hired before 31/12/1988; modelled as max=5 (post-1988 hires, the prevailing case for the active workforce — no one hired before 1988 is still accumulating scatti). Structural engine limitation for the pre-1988 grandfathered cohort.

EAR FOR VIIQ: Allegato 1bis lists EAR only for VII (not VIIQ separately). VIIQ workers receive the same EAR as VII; the distinguishing element is INDENNITA_FUNZIONE (additional allowance for quadri). Structural design: VIIQ base = VII base, VIIQ fixed_allowances includes INDENNITA_FUNZIONE.

UNA TANTUM: backpay EUR 200 paid in July 2024 and EUR 180 in January 2025, uniform for all levels. Not encoded as a una tantum of the agreement: the runs of those months are outside the years the bundle computes (contribution tables from 2026), so the limitation applies to them only.

limitation.remediation: Encode the una tantum (EUR 200 in July 2024, EUR 180 in January 2025) when the bundle computes those years.

notes.text: Allegato 1 nn. 2-5 (p. 32; not art. 18): the superminimi by years in the level are fixed allowances gated on SeniorityFact.career_months: 7 EUR in level IV after 8 years; 7 EUR in level III after 4 years with the role 'diplomato', or after 8 years with the role 'non_diplomato'; 11 EUR in level II after 10 years with the role 'senza_passaggio'.

Allegato 1 nn. 2-5: the superminimi count the years in the level ('permanenza nel livello', 'anzianità di livello'). The run reads SeniorityFact.career_months; without it, it reads the service months, which pay a worker promoted into the level less than the years required.

limitation.remediation: State SeniorityFact.career_months as the months in the current level for the workers of levels II-IV.

reviews.scope: The accrual rule of the tredicesima (fractions of a month) against the full CCNL text.
findings: Art. 17 - Tredicesima e Quattordicesima mensilità (p. 15): "il lavoratore non in prova, avrà diritto a tanti dodicesimi dell'ammontare delle mensilità accessorie e per quanti sono stati i mesi interi di servizio prestato, calcolando come mese intero la frazione di mese uguale o superiore a 15 giorni e trascurando invece quella inferiore a 15 giorni.". Match: at_least 15.

reviews.scope: The comporto and the sick pay of the CCNL counted over several illnesses (work_rules.sickness_rules), read on the signed text.
findings: Art. 26 (pp. 20-21) of the shore-staff section: the comporto is 10 months of one illness and 330 days of several within the last three years, with the whole pay; the carenza of the 4th-6th event of the year is paid 50%, from the 7th 30%. The file kept a comporto of 180 days of one illness with no event reduction: corrected (max_duration_days 304, a window of 36 months and 330 days, carenza_by_event). The 18 months of a serious illness are not modelled.

reviews.scope: Apprentice seniority: Allegato 4 lett. a) (pp. 39, 41) and the aumenti periodici of the sezione personale di terra of 11 July 2024 (OCR).
findings: 'Il periodo di apprendistato si computa ai fini dell'anzianità aziendale e di servizio' (p. 39); 'la percentuale si applica esclusivamente sul minimo contrattuale' (p. 41); the workers get an increment of a fixed amount per level each biennio: the level increments in full.

reviews.scope: The monthly values of the levels against the primary tables (text layer).
findings: 49 values found verbatim on the cited pages and marked verified; 0 left as they were (derived or not on a text page).

reviews.scope: Allegato 1 nn. 2-5 (PDF p. 32), art. 17 and art. 33 of the Sezione personale di terra of 11 July 2024.
findings: The superminimi by years in the level are in Allegato 1 nn. 2-5, not art. 18 as the note said: 7 EUR (IV, 8 years; III, 4 years with a diploma or 8 years), 11 EUR (II, 10 years, no further promotion).
Art. 17 puts the superminimo in the tredicesima and quattordicesima, art. 33 in the TFR base.

reviews.scope: Allegato 1 nn. 2-5 (PDF p. 32) against the encoding of the superminimi by years in the level, by a separate model session.
findings: Confirmed the amounts, levels and thresholds of nn. 2, 3 and 5.
Corrected: n. 4 is for the 'altri impiegati', not every impiegato; n. 3 does not end at eight years (role 'non_diplomato' for n. 4).
Flagged: without career_months the service months stand for the years in the level (limitation level_years_from_service).

provenance.note: Number of monthly payments read from the contract file; no clause is cited for it.

location.section: Art. 26 - Trattamento in caso di malattia o infortunio, B) Trattamento economico, C) Periodo di comporto
location.quote: Nel corso di ciascun anno di calendario, nel caso di susseguirsi di più eventi di malattia (l’ipotesi di continuazione di malattia è considerata un unico evento morboso), il trattamento economico di malattia, anche qualora esso sia erogato dall’INPS, verrà così corrisposto: - per i primi 3 eventi al 100% della retribuzione giornaliera di riferimento; - dal 4° al 6° evento, limitatamente ai primi 3 giorni di malattia (periodo di carenza) indicati nel certificato medico, al 50% della retribuzione giornaliera di riferimento; [...] - dal 7° evento, limitatamente ai primi 3 giorni di malattia (periodo di carenza) indicati nel certificato medico, al 30% della retribuzione giornaliera di riferimento. [...] In caso di assenza per un singolo evento di malattia la Società conserverà al dipendente, non in prova, il posto di lavoro per un periodo almeno pari a 10 mesi, senza interruzione di anzianità, corrispondendo l’intera retribuzione, fermo restando quanto previsto al paragrafo B (comporto secco). Fermo restando quanto previsto al paragrafo B), qualora nell’arco dell’ultimo triennio il dipendente raggiunga, per effetto di più eventi morbosi, assenze complessive per malattia almeno pari a 330 giorni, per i quali sarà corrisposta l’intera retribuzione, la Società potrà procedere alla risoluzione del rapporto di lavoro (comporto per sommatoria).

provenance.transformation: Art. 26 B)-C): the whole pay for every sick day of the comporto; the comporto is 10 months of one illness (304 days, months of 365/12 days, 'comporto secco') and 330 sick days within the last three years (the 36 months that end on the day, 'comporto per sommatoria'). The first 3 days of the 4th to 6th event of the calendar year are paid 50%, of the 7th and later 30%; a continued illness is one event, and the hospital stays, day hospital, dialysis and illnesses of pregnancy are not counted (SicknessEpisode.short_absence_exempt). Read on 2026-10-31.
provenance.note: Art. 26 D): an illness of particular gravity (neoplasie invalidanti, sclerosi multipla, trapianti...) keeps the job 18 months, 540 days within the three years, with the whole pay; the engine applies the ordinary comporto to it.
